sources.finding: Cancellation without market_ticker or exchange_index defaults to shard 0. Supply market_ticker with exchange_index omitted to auto-route.
Shards introduced after August corpus; market exchange_index is authoritative. Collateral must be preallocated on the selected matching engine.
Create with ticker and omitted exchange_index auto-routes.
Omitting exchange_index returns an aggregate across shards; current client parses only aggregate cents.
Authenticated requests have token costs. Current 429 responses have no Retry-After header; clients must back off. Existing lip-q6r scope remains needed.

GET /portfolio/orders omits exchange_index to include all shards; ticker filters the market. This supports the existing sweep read query shape; no authenticated completeness measurement was performed.

Omitted exchange_index includes all shards, but omitted subaccount defaults to primary 0. The client has no explicit subaccount query; account-wide cleanliness needs proof that non-primary subaccounts have no exposure or complete scoped reads.

limitation: Documentation compatibility evidence, not authenticated conformance or a live failure observation.
